headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY
summary: As of September 24, 2026, the portfolio set has delivered an average return of 27.52%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.22%. This results in an average alpha of 14.30%, indicating that the portfolios are not only rising in absolute terms but are also ahead of the benchmark comparison. The top portfolio, 'Random A', achieved a remarkable return of 49.34%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', returned 9.18%, which still reflects resilience compared to the benchmark. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market stress and uncertainty, providing a useful signal of relative strength. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
